# Security policy

## Reporting

Please report vulnerabilities, misuse of a model, or published files that should not be public (for example personal data or copied text) to contact@miskatonic-analytics.com. Do not open a public issue for these. You get an answer within 14 days.

## Scope

The code in this repository, the firmware it builds, and the model cards and files published on Hugging Face under the mobility-model-zoo organization.

## What the models are

The models are research artefacts released as dated snapshots without maintenance promises. They are not safety mechanisms and were not developed under functional-safety or automotive cybersecurity standards. See each model card for intended use, out-of-scope uses and limitations.
